channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA SLPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 03:30 PM 20 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NorthernSamar(LopeDeVega, SilvinoLobos, Mondragon, Catarman), #Sorsogon(Gubat, Magallanes and SantaMagdalena) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthernSamar(Laoang, Palapag), #Sorsogon(Bulusan, Barcelona, Casiguran, Irosin and Juban) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
